mentions.name: Solitairle
mentions.description: This is an ad-free Yukon solitaire game in which every board is guaranteed solvable. A new solvable challenge is released each day, with helpful tools such as a back button and dead-end warnings so players can win through skill rather than luck.
mentions.problem: Most solitaire apps frustrate players with impossible games or endless randomness.
mentions.audience: People who enjoy casual puzzle games but get discouraged by unwinnable setups, and who value clean, minimalist interfaces without ads

mentions.name: Solitairle
mentions.description: A daily Yukon solitaire game in which every board is guaranteed solvable. It offers a new challenge each day, a back button, dead-end warnings, player stats, and a clean, minimalist ad-free interface focused on satisfying wins through skill rather than luck.
mentions.problem: Most solitaire apps frustrate players with impossible games or endless randomness; Solitairle is designed for people who want a satisfying win through skill, not luck.
mentions.audience: Casual puzzle game players who get discouraged by unwinnable setups and value clean, minimalist interfaces without ads.
